meta.question: on Aircraft (final, seeds 1-3, K=29), after held-out 2-fold temperature scaling, is the student's non-target class distribution further from the full teacher's for MaskedKD than for Rollout / TrustMask_v1?
meta.method: per run, fit one softmax temperature on half of val (index parity), apply on the other half; per image KL(teacher || student) over the non-target classes (true label removed, renormalised); paired MaskedKD@29 - selector@29 and selector@29 - Full; image bootstrap and seed t CI
